Keywords in the program¶

This page lists the keyword names that the Priroda 25 (2025.02.28) executable reads, found by examining the program file itself. Names that this manual documents are links into the input reference; the others are only known to exist. Their meaning is unknown, so do not use them in production work.

A name listed here is accepted by the program; a name that is not listed stops the run with *** error in '$group' : unknown name …, as long as the task reads that group. Any unique prefix of a name is accepted, so sym=1 in $optimize means symmetry=1 and dist= in $uniq means distance=.

Groups for everyday work¶

Group

Keywords

$system

memory, path, disk

$control

task, theory, four, a137, state, weight, basis, nucleus, field, derivative, fit, wavelength, save, print

$scf

restrict, convergence, iterations, procedure, d1small, core, occupation, fraction, temperature, ttype, diagm, xmax, n1, fitxc, eemin, mab, aw, wv

$dft

functional, zero, n, p

$grid

accuracy, type, cutoff, nradial, nadd, use43

$integral

direct, routine, storage, invert, cutij, vcut

$atoms

core, mcore, nc, no, active, mocc, occupation, diagonalize

$guess

read, mix, na, nb, n, a, type, gradient, localize

$optimize

saddle, tolerance, trust, steps, follow, points, back, down, radius, fix, value, coordinates, cartesian, symmetry, gradient, print, exact, bend, local, circle, weight, massweight, minimize, maximize, cubicfit, energy, de0, fragment, noise, state

$d2edr2

length, steps, displace

$thermo

sigma, temperature, mass, project, localize, diagonalize

$nmr

standard, points

$Energy

e, g, h, d, a, dx, ax, r

$uniq

distance, file

$dynamic

t, e, n, m, a, b, c, i, o, z, y, dx, kd, lw, hb, rb, pb, v1, frag, file, fprint

$molecule is read differently from the other groups, so its keywords (charge, mult, cartesian, z-matrix, set, unit, sym) could not be listed from the program; see $molecule. Group names are case-insensitive: the program looks for $energy, which is the same group as $Energy. It is also read as $energy001, $energy002 and so on, for tasks with several structures.

$fmatrix, $ce, $ca, $cb

starting orbitals given in the input

$scf (QM model)

Further groups ($molbf, $moldf, $mbf, $mdf, $esp, $bond, $e2r6, $geometry, $dmtype, $mm, $order, $bf, $c6p, $hferror (angular, radial), $mpitest, $multiply, $gtest) serve the parametrization of the model Hamiltonians or the developer’s own tests.

Task names¶

The program recognizes these values of task. Only the first group is documented or tested.

  • Documented: energy, gradient, hessian, optimize, optimize+hessian, irc, scan, nmr, dipole, anharmonic, thermostat, uniq, opt_n1, saddle, transit, extremal, conical, path.

  • Not documented: irc4, dipole1, dipole1x, dipole2, polarizability, numeric, loop, stretch, extremal2, path0, pathr, pathx, chain, press, forceconst, potential, dynamic, dynamicn2, dynamic1p, walk, mm0dimer, dimer, orient, guess, fragment_guess, nss_num, steric, compare, isogrid, functional, d1fit, df1_n4, df2_n4, df2_e_n4, mbf2, molbf, moldf, dmtype, am_integral, and developer tests (mpitest, multiply, etest, fmtest, ritest, riopt, test_v).

check is not a task name. Like any unknown task name, task=check sets up the run and stops quietly, which is why it seems to work. An unknown theory= name is worse: the program runs Hartree–Fock without a message.

Theory names¶

Besides the methods described in theory, the program contains these method names, none of which is documented: OSDFT, DFT_CNO, LEDFT, LE1DFT, DFCIS, RIHFDF, MP4D, PT4DQ, PT4SDQ, PT4SDTQ, CISD, CCD4S, CCD4ST, CCD&MP2, LCCD+MP2, SN_CCD&MP2, SN_CCSD&MP2, LEHF, LEHF_N3, LEMP2_N3, LE2HF_N3, LE2MP2_N3, MCSCF, CASSCF, GSCI, the model Hamiltonians QM_N2, QM_N2D, QM_N2B, QM_N2B3, QM_N2C, QM_N2C0, QM_N2F, AM_N1, MM0_N2, DM_1, BM_1, MM_1, and 6-12, FREP, SCRIPT.
